Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the directors' birth years, stating that 1899 (Edwin L. Marin) is later than 1928 (Lina Wertmüller). This logical inversion led to the wrong conclusion that Henry Goes Arizona has the director born later, when in fact The Blue Collar Worker and the Hairdresser in a Whirl of Sex and Politics does.
